pictures.name: RMI1-Konya
pictures.prompt: Konya in Anatolia in 1244, a medieval town of brick domes, slender minarets and a busy lane with carpet sellers. In the middle, Jalal al-Din Rumi, painted with dignity and respect, a scholar in his late thirties with a dark beard and kind, serious eyes, in a long dark blue scholar’s robe and a white turban, walks with a few young students carrying bound books, people nodding respectfully as he passes. Warm afternoon gold light, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: RMI2-The-Pool
pictures.prompt: A tiled courtyard in medieval Konya with a still square pool and a fig tree. Jalal al-Din Rumi, painted with dignity and respect, a scholar in his late thirties with a dark beard and kind, serious eyes, in a long dark blue scholar’s robe and a white turban, sits on a carpet by the water reading, a stack of handwritten leather-bound books beside him. In an archway behind him stands Shams of Tabriz, painted with dignity and respect, a lean, weathered wanderer of about sixty with a grey beard and piercing but kindly eyes, in a rough dark felt cloak and a simple black cap, watching. Soft late light, reflections in the water. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: RMI3-Books-In-Water
pictures.prompt: A tiled courtyard in medieval Konya by a square pool. Shams of Tabriz, painted with dignity and respect, a lean, weathered wanderer of about sixty with a grey beard and piercing but kindly eyes, in a rough dark felt cloak and a simple black cap, holds up dripping leather-bound books he has just lifted from the water, perfectly dry inside, with a fierce, knowing look. Jalal al-Din Rumi, painted with dignity and respect, a scholar in his late thirties with a dark beard and kind, serious eyes, in a long dark blue scholar’s robe and a white turban, has half risen from his carpet, amazed. Ripples on the pool, gold light, a sense of wonder. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. pictures.name: RMI4-Friends
pictures.prompt: A lamplit room in medieval Konya with carpets and cushions. Jalal al-Din Rumi, painted with dignity and respect, a scholar in his late thirties with a dark beard and kind, serious eyes, in a long dark blue scholar’s robe and a white turban, and Shams of Tabriz, painted with dignity and respect, a lean, weathered wanderer of about sixty with a grey beard and piercing but kindly eyes, in a rough dark felt cloak and a simple black cap, sit facing each other in deep, joyful conversation, cups of water between them. In the doorway, two young students peek in with jealous, unhappy faces. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue night at the window. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. pictures.name: RMI5-The-Reed
pictures.prompt: Night in a quiet room in medieval Konya. Jalal al-Din Rumi, painted with dignity and respect, a scholar in his late thirties with a dark beard and kind, serious eyes, in a long dark blue scholar’s robe and a white turban, sits alone by an open arched window, holding a simple reed flute in his hands, eyes closed, grieving and tender. Across from him, an empty cushion. Moonlight on a reed bed by a distant river. Deep blue and silver, one small lamp. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame.
